en.headline: Jewellery shop barred from tour groups for 30 days over coerced shopping
en.dek: The Travel Industry Authority suspended Kaiser Jewellery International from receiving inbound tour groups after finding it failed to stop a guide coercing mainland visitors into purchases.
body: The Travel Industry Authority has suspended Kaiser Jewellery International Limited from receiving any inbound tour group visitors for 30 days, from 26 August to 24 September, after an investigation into a February case involving mainland Chinese visitors.

The authority found the registered shop, trading as Kai Xuan Jewellery and Jade Cultural Museum and operating outlets including one at Harbourside HQ in Kowloon Bay, did not make sufficient efforts to stop a tour guide from coercing passengers into shopping and failed to take reasonable measures to prevent unauthorised persons from promoting products inside the premises.

Directors, managers and all frontline staff of the shop must complete designated training courses within one month. The authority reiterated its zero-tolerance stance on coerced shopping and any conduct that damages Hong Kong’s tourism reputation.

zh.headline: 凱旋珠寶未制止導遊威迫購物 被旅監局停接待旅行團30日
zh.dek: 旅遊業監管局因2月一宗內地旅行團個案，暫停Kaiser Jewellery International註冊商店資格，由8月26日至9月24日不得接待訪港旅行團。
body: 旅遊業監管局宣布，因應今年2月一宗涉及內地入境旅行團旅客被威迫購物的個案，暫停以「凱旋珠寶玉石文化館」經營的Kaiser Jewellery International Limited的註冊商店資格，為期30日，由8月26日起至9月24日，期間不得接待任何訪港旅行團旅客。
旅監局調查後發現，涉事商店未有盡力制止有關導遊威迫旅客購物，以及未有採取合理及適當措施確保沒有非獲授權人士在店內向旅客宣傳或推廣產品，違反行政計劃下的承諾。
涉事商店的董事、經理及所有前線員工須於一個月內修畢旅監局指明的培訓課程。旅監局重申對威迫購物及任何損害本港旅遊業聲譽的行為採取零容忍態度。
